items.title: UNDP and Adaptation Fund equip water users in Kafernighan River
items.one_liner: UNDP and the Adaptation Fund equipped water user associations for climate resilience in the Kafernighan River Basin.
items.why: Directly informs water resource management, annual water yield, and community-based adaptation in regional river basins.
items.action: Examine the project documentation to understand water user association involvement in basin-level resilience.

items.title: Green Climate Fund Approves Record $3.3B Climate Investments
items.one_liner: The Green Climate Fund approved a record $3.3 billion in new climate investments.
items.why: Highlights major international funding streams available for climate adaptation, green-blue infrastructure, and urban resilience.
items.action: Check the GCF project portfolio to see how urban ecosystem service projects secure international climate finance.

items.title: EBRD and Green Climate Fund Allocate €87m for Greener Cities
items.one_liner: The EBRD and Green Climate Fund allocated €87 million to support greener urban development initiatives.
items.why: Provides concrete funding examples for urban green-blue infrastructure and municipal environmental planning.
items.action: Review the allocation criteria used in the EBRD Greener Cities framework for urban green space projects.

items.title: Delhi Declaration 2026 Calls for Stronger City Role in Climate Governance
items.one_liner: The Delhi Declaration 2026 called for a stronger role for cities in climate governance ahead of COP31.
items.why: Emphasizes urban-level climate governance and multi-level policy integration crucial for Global South cities.
items.action: Read the text of the Delhi Declaration to understand municipal advocacy points for upcoming climate summits.

items.title: Southeast Asian voices on climate change in Nature
items.one_liner: Nature published perspectives highlighting Southeast Asian voices on climate change.
items.why: Provides regional insights into climate vulnerabilities and urban environmental adaptations in the Global South.
items.action: Read the Nature article to gather regional perspectives on climate resilience and nature-based solutions.

items.title: EBRD and GCF back Uzbekistan GEFF phase with up to US$20M
items.one_liner: EBRD and the Green Climate Fund backed Uzbekistan's GEFF phase with up to $20 million for green financial systems.
items.why: Offers a relevant case study on greening financial systems and urban infrastructure in semi-arid Central Asian settings.
items.action: Investigate the GEFF financing mechanism structure for applicability to Central Asian urban environments like Kabul.

items.title: Global EbA Fund and CBA SCALE+ convene COP17 side event
items.one_liner: Global EbA Fund and CBA SCALE+ convened a side event on scaling community-led ecosystem-based adaptation.
items.why: Focuses on community-led ecosystem-based adaptation (EbA), aligning with urban nature access and social-ecological systems.
items.action: Look for summary notes or outputs from the side event regarding community-led EbA scaling strategies.

items.title: Accelerating Data-Driven Water Management
items.one_liner: A publication discussed approaches for accelerating data-driven water management from commitment to action.
items.why: Supports methodological learning in spatial modeling, data-scarce environmental monitoring, and water yield assessment.
items.action: Read the report to identify practical data-driven tools applicable to hydrological ecosystem services.

items.title: Singapore advances carbon market innovation and financing
items.one_liner: Singapore has advanced its carbon market innovation and financing frameworks.
items.why: Relevant for exploring innovative financing mechanisms for urban environmental planning and green infrastructure in the Global…
items.action: Review Singapore's carbon market frameworks for potential adaptation to data-scarce urban contexts.

items.title: EU wants capitals to adjust to warming of 3°C
items.one_liner: The EU urged capital cities to prepare and adapt for a warming scenario of 3°C.
items.why: Connects with urban cooling, heat mitigation strategies, and scenario comparison for climate change adaptation planning.
items.action: Review the EU's capital adaptation guidelines for insights on urban heat island mitigation planning.
